package rulefixtures

import "strings"

// scenario for go_perf_layer_string_handling_string_lower_for_case_insensitive_compare: Layer: String handling. Flag lowercasing both sides for case-insensitive compare in hot paths.
// fixture polarity: negative; family: performance; severity: contextual.
func scenario572Negative(values []string) []string {
	out := make([]string, 0, len(values))
	for _, v := range values {
		out = append(out, strings.ToLower(v))
	}
	return out
}
